newsitem.title: USA: Midas picks four agencies to compete for account.
newsitem.headline: Midas picks four agencies to compete for account.

text.p: Midas International Corp, the world's largest franchised automotive service operation, said Friday it has named four Chicago agencies to make presentations in its search for a national advertising agency to succeed J. Walter Thompson USA on the $25 million account.

The four agencies named to compete for the account include DDB Needham, Euro RSCG Tatham, Cramer-Krasselt, and Foote, Cone and Belding. They will make presentations in late July, Midas said in a news release.
Foote, Cone and Belding is a subsidiary of True North Communications Inc.
In late June, Whitman Corp announced its plan to spin off Midas from its parent as a publicly traded independent company.
Midas, which operates more than 2,500 stores in 17 countries, reported systemwide sales and revenues of more than $1.3 billion in 1996.
Officials of Midas and J. Walter Thompson were not immediately available to provide more information.
